task.title: Add trace-aware resume handoff bootstrap
task.summary: Make the current resume/context-boundary tooling preserve the accepted trace-primary decision handoff before deeper refactor work or session refreshes.

goal.outcome: Agents can safely refresh or start a new session from a compact source-backed trace-primary handoff before the full trace storage refactor lands.
acceptance: Resume/context packets include approved decision build refs, decision gateway refs, approved row ids, KB/diagram refs, risk/impact summary, downstream planning questions, blockers, and next safe actions.
The packet explicitly records bootstrap mode: current Pi extension/tools remain authoritative until an agent requests `/reload` after source/prompt/skill changes.
A fresh session can recover the planning/implementation handoff from CodeWiki source refs without relying on chat history or the future lifecycle trace implementation.
Existing resume/compaction smoke tests are updated or extended to prove no approved decision context is lost across a refresh boundary.
No package skill removal or source-root migration is performed in this task.
non_goals: Do not implement full lifecycle trace storage or catalog.
Do not change public /wiki command semantics beyond resume packet content.
Do not require `/reload` until source/prompt/skill behavior actually changes.

delta.desired: Resume/context tooling preserves the approved trace-primary architecture handoff compactly before deep refactor work.
delta.current: Decision pass recommends context boundary, but resume tooling is not yet trace-primary and may omit new semantic gate/trace refs.
delta.closure: Task closes when fresh-session recovery can start from build/gateway/KB refs and no approved decision context is lost.
